input.text: The customer reports that the receiving partner found a mark on the left rear and sent two photos. They cannot say when it was first noticed. This is a claim, not a damage finding.

The records disagree on where the car is. The order says DELIVERED (Oliver Karvenby's job completed, promised for 16 Oct), but a second job with Alex Forvelin on the same route started today at 10:11 Helsinki time, and the driver app shows the car moving with 237 km left. It is not clear which handover the mark claim is about.
Alex Forvelin took pickup photos this morning but is not sure they clearly show the left rear, and will send them. They saw no mark at pickup but did not look closely at that corner.

The app's arrival estimate was 22 Oct 12:00 Helsinki time, but the requested delivery slot is 23 Oct 11:00–16:00 Helsinki time. The driver did not know this and now plans to deliver on 23 Oct in that window. The delivery contact, Gemma Briarmere, has not yet confirmed they can take the car then.

draft_message.body: CD-420055, Bentley Continental GT. The customer says the receiving partner found a mark on the left rear. They sent 2 photos and cannot say when it was first noticed. Nothing has been found or blamed on anyone yet. The earlier proposal to blame the delivery driver was rejected. Records disagree: the order says DELIVERED (Oliver Karvenby, 16 Oct), but Alex Forvelin picked the car up again today at 10:11 Helsinki time and is driving to Turku. Alex says they saw no mark at pickup but did not look closely at the left rear. They are sending their photos and are not sure the photos cover that corner. Please: 1) confirm which handover the claim is about, 2) compare all four photo sets, 3) reply to the customer once the evidence is reviewed. Separately: Alex now plans to deliver on 23 Oct 11:00–16:00 Helsinki time, but the delivery contact, Gemma Briarmere, has not confirmed that window.

input.what_happens_next: Once approved, the case goes to an operator with this brief. Alex Forvelin's pickup photos get added to the evidence when they arrive.
input.what_happens_after: An operator owns the claim, compares the evidence and decides what to tell the customer.
